box_reviews.final: actions extérieures possibles \unsure{des|de} sous-groupes\inserted{ ouverts} $\Gamma$ de $\Gamma_{\mathbb{Q}}$ sur de tels groupes fondamen-taux -- et éventuellement question
box_reviews.ink: The first d/e has a short dark terminal return that does not settle des/de: add local doubt, retaining des first. Gamma and its subscript use the existing conventional font; no extra prime or leg appears. A real detached hyphen follows fondamen at the line edge, so restore fondamen-taux. The question ending has no separate final s. Insertion spaces and the prose-dash encoding are typographic.

The dark first cluster has s/u/r and the tall t course. The next cluster begins with a rounded o, not a new tall t as avant tout would require. Keep the single live word surtout; the clearly separate strike across topos is not present here. The raised variétés remains attached to topos.

box_reviews.final: modulaires pour des courbes algébriques\ldots) À partir de là, \unsure{$\leftarrow$|on} \unsure{reconstruirait|reconstruira}
box_reviews.ink: The mark after là, has a pointed left end and a thin shaft; separate o/n letter bodies are not secure, so put the left arrow first with on as alternative. The verb ending has a raised loop and short transverse return consistent with final t but compressed enough to admit reconstruira; retain reconstruirait first with doubt. Three actual points before the closing parenthesis are encoded by ldots.

box_reviews.final: type fini sur $\mathbb{Q}$ (ou plutôt, la catégorie de ceux-là\ldots), ou plus gén. sur un
box_reviews.ink: The short opening word is de. The following course has c/e/u/x, a detached short hyphen, a tall l loop, and low a with a raised accent: retain ceux-là, not connexes. Q font and the three-point encoding are conventional.

box_reviews.final: ``recollement'', la catégorie des schémas loc de type fini sur \unsure{$q$|\deleted{d}|\deleted{f}|$\forall$} un $K$ -- tout \unsure{au|du} moins la cat. des fractions qui s'en
box_reviews.ink: The complete sign-plus-un-K context was reread. The rounded left bowl and long right descent support q as primary; upper extension and dark lower retracing admit cancelled d/f, while the inherited universal reading remains an alternative. There is no independently certain cancelling stroke. The first word after the dash has two t-like rises, supporting tout. The next bowl and high return leave au/du unresolved. Dash length is typography; neither dont des nor an omitted sign is adopted.

The accent, low e, g descender and l loop survive the cancellation. The post-l low course and dark terminal rise could be ant, but the strike obscures segmentation. Retain égale first and add égalant; do not present the blind longer word as certain.
